title: Young Child with Easter Basket by House, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot of a young child, seen from behind, dressed in dark trousers or dungarees and a long-sleeve sweater, searching the garden foliage alongside the foundation of a home. The child carries a woven Easter basket with a high handle, searching near a bush nestled into the corner where painted white wood siding meets a white brick chimney or wall. The reverse side features black album mounting paper residue in the corners, indicating it was once lovingly preserved in a mid-century family photo album.
